summary: A legal and regulatory day, dominated by judicial appointments securing all High Courts with permanent Chief Justices, alongside market and retail sector developments including Sebi's hasty retreat from a volatility-prone auction reform and Reliance's planned $1.3 billion rupee bond issuance.

bullets.text: Centre cleared 8 Collegium recommendations, ensuring all 25 High Courts now have permanent Chief Justices.
Sebi's market-closing auction reform, designed to curb price manipulation, rolled back within weeks due to volatility and investor backlash.
Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion via 5-year rupee bonds next week—its first rupee bond sale since 2023.
Vadilal Enterprises blocked renewal of its 10-year distribution pact with ice cream maker Vadilal Industries.
Anthropic projects profitability for second consecutive quarter with gross margins above 80% before training and distribution costs.
